messages:
dave: Quick check: Do we want to include "profiling cadence" in the initial spec? If a model is stable maybe we only profile weekly vs daily.

mina: Yes. Different customers will have different churn. Proposal: default weekly, configurable down to daily for high-change models, and up to monthly for very stable ones.

olga: That will affect cost curve. We should surface estimated monthly profiling cost per cadence in the UI.

kevin: Also we need to ensure profiling runs are interruptible and resumable to avoid runaway infra usage.

dave: Draft AC: 
```
AC-PROF-1: Default profiling cadence = weekly; UI allows 24h/weekly/monthly.
AC-PROF-2: UI shows estimated monthly cost for chosen cadence before enabling.
AC-PROF-3: Profiling tasks are interruptible; progress saved and resumed within 24h window.
```

mina: Good. Also we should recommend default sample sizes by cadence (daily=500, weekly=1000, monthly=2000).

olga: For pilots, cap at 1000/week to control spend.

ci-bot: smoke test passed for profiler-runner branch.
